en: An illustrated postcard featuring a large, ornate statue set on a multi-tiered pedestal. The statue is of a standing figure with one arm outstretched. The pedestal has relief carvings and other figures. In the sky to the left, cherubs or putti carry a shield with a red cross, and there are swirling clouds. In the background, there are mountains and trees, suggesting an Alpine landscape. There is Italian text in the upper right corner, and the artist's signature appears on the lower right.
